_comment: 2017 counterpart of trijet_data_2018_minimal_rho_pairsplit.json. Systematics-grade minimal_rho trijet DATA production on the 2026-08-06 pair_split fiducial. The systematic profile is left at minimal_syst because it is a no-op on data: the jetsyst loop skips every non-nominal entry when do_gen is False, and the data weights object carries no variations, so data is nominal-only by construction whatever the profile says. Also carries the per-jet kinematic validation hists, which is the point of the run -- they are the data leg of the per-year pair_split kinematic data/MC ratios. JetHT Run2017B-F, 260 files. Era plumbing for 2017: JEC Summer19UL17_V6_MC / Summer19UL17_Run{B..F}_V6_DATA, JER Summer19UL17_JRV3_MC, lumi 41.48 fb^-1, golden JSON Cert_294927-306462_13TeV_UL2017_Collisions17_GoldenJSON.txt, prescales/ps_weight_JSON_2017.json. The fileset qualifier that selects this era's datasets is set by notebook_utils.HADRONIC_ERAS_DATA; the processor re-derives the same IOV from the DAS name, so nothing here needs an explicit IOV key.
